name: SolidCraft
tagline: Free, open-source 3D design software you can run in your browser or on your desktop - or let your AI agent drive it.
sentence: A parametric CAD tool built in Rust that runs on your desktop, in the browser, from the command line, or as a plugin your AI agent can control.
replaces: Paying for SolidWorks or Fusion 360 to design 3D parts

visual.alt: SolidCraft's desktop editor showing a Raspberry Pi enclosure being designed - a 3D view of an open-top case with rounded edges, the parametric feature timeline visible on the left side.
visual.caption: Parametric 3D modeling in SolidCraft's desktop editor - a Raspberry Pi enclosure with editable dimensions.

board.say: Professional 3D design software costs hundreds per year, and the free options either lack parametric tools or run only on one platform.
You download SolidCraft or open it in a browser and start modeling a part.
Your design idea - a bracket, an enclosure, a gear, a shelf mount - described in words, a sketch, or drawn with the tool's parametric editor.
It gives you a full parametric modeling environment with constraints, sketches and a timeline.
steps: You create 2D sketches with lines, arcs, circles and constraints (like 'this edge stays parallel to that one')
You turn sketches into 3D shapes with operations like extrude, revolve and fillet
Every step is tracked in a timeline so you can go back and change a dimension and everything downstream updates

board.say: A 3D model you can export, 3D-print, or hand to a manufacturer.

outputs.eg: A phone stand with adjustable dimensions that updates when you change the phone width
STL files for 3D printing, STEP files for manufacturing
When using the browser version, a link anyone can open to view or remix your design

before: Professional CAD costs $500+/year (SolidWorks, Fusion 360) or locks your files in the cloud
Free alternatives like FreeCAD have steep learning curves and no AI integration
Sharing a design means exporting files and emailing them
after: A free, open-source parametric CAD that runs on desktop, in the browser, or from the command line
A plugin lets your AI agent create and modify 3D models for you
Designs live in standard formats you own - no vendor lock-in
uses_note: SolidCraft is 16 days old. Hackaday commenters report modifying designs and exporting to PrusaSlicer, but documented production use is still early.

coverage.title: SolidCraft - Open-Source Parametric CAD in Rust with MCP Support
SolidCraft Is Parametric, Automation-friendly CAD For Desktop And Browser

steps: [Open SolidCraft in your browser](https://solidcraft.io) - no download needed, it runs in Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
Or [download the desktop app](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/releases) for Mac, Windows (also via `winget install solidcraft`), or Linux.
Start with the built-in tutorial: sketch a rectangle, constrain its dimensions, extrude it into a box, and fillet the edges.
try.paste:
/skillspector https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft
(SolidCraft runs in the browser at solidcraft.io or as a desktop app. Try the browser version first, then install the desktop app from the releases page.)

footprint.disk: The desktop app is roughly 50-100 MB. Source build needs Rust toolchain (~1 GB with dependencies).
footprint.memory: Runs on modest hardware. The browser version works in any modern browser.
footprint.runs_on: Mac, Windows, Linux (desktop). Any modern browser (web version). MCP server for AI agents.

best_for: Hobbyists and makers who want parametric CAD without paying for SolidWorks
Anyone who wants to describe a part to an AI agent and get a 3D model back
Teams who need to share designs in a browser without installing software
skip_if: You need production-grade CAD with assembly tools and simulation (use Fusion 360 or SolidWorks)
You already have a CAD tool you're productive in
You need NURBS surfaces for organic shapes (SolidCraft is focused on solid modeling)

alternatives.name: FreeCAD
alternatives.line: The established open-source parametric CAD - more mature but no browser version or AI integration

alternatives.name: OpenSCAD
alternatives.line: Code-based 3D modeling - write scripts instead of drawing, good for programmers

watch: **16 days old.** The feature set is growing fast (1,937 commits, v0.15.0) but expect rough edges - slow fillets and booleans are known issues.
**Unsigned installers.** The Windows and Mac desktop installers are not code-signed, so your OS will warn you when you install them.
**Longevity uncertain.** HN commenters worry about long-term maintenance. CAD files need to stay openable for years, and a 16-day-old project has not proven that yet.
**Large STEP imports may fail.** A Hackaday commenter could not load a large 3D printer STEP file. Complex imported models may hit limits.
